state_planes.concrete: Global/shared Mem bytes plus byte Sh; local sparse (aligned u32 address,u64 value+undefined mask); TMEM u32 words+Sh+init.

state_planes.half: HalfState.mem byte-origin map, f16_nodes encoding-kind set, and gwritten global-byte set.

state_planes.fallback: NumState.written blocks initial f32 global word fallback; HalfState.gwritten separately blocks per-byte half fallback.
